Marta Kim: Quick flag — CS reported leads briefly showing unassigned during AUS morning. sounds like a combination of HubSpot webhook burst + enrichment backpressure. can we instrument a tracing probe end-to-end?
Owen Hale: yes. goal: prove where time is spent (recv -> enrich -> rr_assign -> first_sdr_touch). want minimal, privacy-safe payload.
Priya Nair: legal ok if lead id is salted+hashed and no contact fields. add consent_flag and opt-out metadata.probe=false.
Diego Morales: propose events at three checkpoints: webhook_recv, enrich_done, assign_done. Sample 5% initially, higher on internal tenants. include `connector` (hubspot|salesforce), `tenant_tier` (trial|paid|enterprise), `weekday_or_weekend`.
Marta Kim: also capture `owner_type` (rr|default|manual), `fallback_reason` if any, and `rr_host` to detect owner skew. we saw ownership hysteresis last week where same owner got many claims.
Owen Hale: add `assign_path` (fast-path|deferred|backfill) so dashboard can show where assignment came from. SLO target: assign within 90s. set `slo_breach` boolean.
Priya Nair: include a privacy rule: drop events for tenants with < 2 leads/min to avoid re-identification. add `lead_hash` only.
